turns.text: patient doesnt remember his abha number, only knows mobile. how to find it

must_contain: Search with POST /abha/api/v3/profile/account/abha/search, scope search-abha and the encrypted mobile number, which returns a txnId and the accounts on that mobile, each with an index, a masked ABHA number, name and gender.
After the person picks an account, request the OTP with loginHint set to index, the encrypted index as loginId and the same txnId, then verify it.
Never skip the OTP because the search already returned an account, since the search alone is a lookup of somebody's identity.
notes:
Find ABHA is a separate journey from login and people try to stop after the search. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/flows/m1-find-abha.md, 'POST /abha/api/v3/profile/account/abha/search
scope [search-abha], mobile (encrypted)'; 'The response carries a `txnId` and the accounts on that mobile, each with an `index`, a masked ABHA number, name and gender'; 'Request the OTP with `loginHint` set to `index`, the encrypted index as `loginId` and the same `txnId`, then verify it'; 'Never skip the OTP because the search already returned an account: search alone is a lookup of somebody's identity.' catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m1-find-abha-search.md, 'Send the person's encrypted mobile number with `scope` set to `["search-abha"]`.'
